# cats. coffees. codes.

> Personal site of Ria Gino — freelance full-stack web developer. The site is a small collection of personal projects, experiments, and web things, organized as three sections: cats, coffees, and codes.

## Pages

- [codes.](https://catscoffeescodes.com/codes): Ria's freelance web development work — services offered, how she works with clients, and selected project case studies.
- [cats.](https://catscoffeescodes.com/cats): Placeholder page, cat photos coming soon.
- [coffees.](https://catscoffeescodes.com/coffees): Placeholder page, travel and photography content coming soon.
